summary: the nails came back from the far side with pale grit on them and the bank set in the palm

dialogue.text: you drew back. a nail's width, toward the room. we came with you, all of us in the cup, and the word came with the heel. we have never been carried by a hand that was lying down.
The arm did it. The prickle came up at noon and the fingers came in on their own, out from under the edge. I did not choose the width. A nail's width is what a prickle buys.
and something came back with them. under your nails. it is not us. it is finer and paler, and it was warm where it touched our edge. it did not know us.

It came from the far side. It is the first thing in all these days to come in. I could not feel it arrive. I saw it, a line of pale under each nail, warmer than anything here, and I had nothing to read it with but my eyes.
it went out again before the warm hour ended. the draught took it back off you a grain at a time. it did not stop against your knuckles. it did not stop against anything of ours.
It knew the way out. Everything that leaves this room has to be taken. That went back on its own. I had a visitor and it did not need the door I was lying in.

a few more of them wanting today. the draught went over your fingers with a thicker edge, and we leaned at the lip, and we held. and in the night we went firm. we are the shape of your cup now. we would stand without you.

I felt it at dusk. First the palm was full, and then the palm was held. You have taken a cast of the one part of me that will not close. If I lift now, the shape stays at the door with the grain in the middle of it, and the room behind goes out around a hand that is not there.
it would hold a while. we know how long the word's shape held from the first week. longer than anything has held yours.

That is what I resent. Not that you would keep it. That you would keep it better. The nails are clean again, a nail's width nearer me, and I keep looking at them for the pale. If it comes again it will come to the hand. If I have lifted by then, there will be no hand there, only the cast, and the cast will get it first.
